tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad rig 'dzin

gzhon nu'i rol rtsed ces bya ba rgyud don mtha' dag gsal ba bzhugs/ dza yantu/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs ngur smrig gi /tshon rgyas rab dkar sbags pa'i bzlos gar mkhan/ /snying po'i don mchog rtsol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ khyab bdag rigs brgya'i mgon por phyag bgyi'o/ /shes bya'i mtha' gru 'jam pa'i mkhyen pa la/ /blo gros gter ba'i lha zhes 'od stong can/ /rmongs pa'i smag rum 'joms la zla bral ba/ /yongs 'dzin rta bdun rgyal po khyod min su/ /gang yang 'di ni rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gzhu/ /gyen du blangs las legs bshad nyag phran sogs/ /dpung pa'i yal gar bzung nas sngon rabs kyi/ / gzhung lugs rnam par 'bigs 'di lan brgyr 'phang*/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i zab don dundhu bhi/ /bskul mkhas dbyug gu'i 'byed pa mang bsten kyang*/ / 'khrul med lam 'dis lugs ngan 'brug sgra'i brug /'gog nus 'di la grogs dag yi rang byos/ / zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ 'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po kyai rdo rje las brtsams te/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag cung zad 'chad pa la/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa mdo tsam bstan pa dang*/ rim gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rjod byed tshig gi rgyud rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde gang du gtogs pa dang*/ gsung pa po ston pa'i che ba/ rgyud nyid ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos thams cad kyi snying po/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyang rgyud sde bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de lhag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/

/de la yang thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud gnyis sam/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du grags pa la/ 'di ma rgyud khyad par can ni/ gnyis med kyi rgyud yin ces 'chad la/ de las kyang snying por gyur pa kyai rdo rje'i rgyud do/ / gnyis pa la spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud thams cad kha sbyor ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs pa yin cing*/ de las kyang rgyud 'di nyid ni dag bya dag byed kyi chos du mas khyad par du 'phags pa'i snying po kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam pa can gyis gsungs par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ /de yang dag pa'i 'khor gyi nang du 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang he ru ka'i/ rnam par gsungs pa yin kyang*/ bar bar du nub par gyur pa las/ 'o skol gyi ston pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe 'og min du longs sku'i rten dang*/ byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje gdan du sprul pa he ru ka'i skur bzhengs nas bdud kyi sde bcom ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ lha dang*/ klu la sogs pa skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la rgyud 'di nyid gsungs pa yin no/ / gsum pa rgyud nyid ngos bzung ba la/ rgyud rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ 'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje/ /las ni dkyil 'khor lnga gsungs pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi dum bu dang*/ sngags kyi dum bu dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i dum bu dang*/ lha'i dum bu dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi dum bu ste/ re re la shlau ka 'bum phrag re re ste 'bum phrag lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /gnyis pa bsdus pa'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal brtag pa gnyis pa yin la/

gnyis pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur dang*/ thun mong pa yang dag sbyor ba sambu ṭi'i rgyud do/ / gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ phyag rgya chen po thig le dang*/ ye shes thig le dang*/ ye shes snying po dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud de thig le bskor bzhi dang*/ rdo rje a ralli dang*/ ri ṣi a ralli dang*/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud rnams so/ /de yang rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'di/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las phyung ba yin zhing*/ de la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma byung na yang*/ brtag pa phyi ma gnyis phyung bar bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed do/ /'di la 'grel byed tshad dang ldan pa mang du byung mod/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du shing rta'i srol byed tha dad du grags pa med la/ bod yul 'dir lugs srol mang du byung ba las/ dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras la bka' bab pa ni/ slob dpon mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i man ngag gi lugs dang*/ grub chen ḍombi he ru ka rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lugs dang*/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs te/ bka' babs bzhir grags pa la dang*/ gzhan yang nā ro pa dang*/ mai tri pa'i lugs re drug go /de la dang po ni/ snyan brgyud gtso che ba yin zhing*/ skabs 'dir gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo yin pas/ ḍom bu'i lugs sogs phyi ma gsum la ni/ ji skad du/ snying po'i don gyi kyai rdor ni/ /birwa'i rjes 'brang ḍom pa'i skor/ /yan lag med rjes padma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu /zhes rgya gzhung sum su cu so dgu yod cing*/ nā ro pa'i lugs ni pham mthing ba nas brgyud/ mal lo tsā ba la bla ma sa skya pas gsan par snang zhing*/ mai tri pa'i lugs la sgrub thabs dang*/ yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa drug bzhugs so/

/ gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang*/ /mi phrogs pa yis rab phye ba/ /rangabazhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs shes bya ba yin/ /de ni mi phrogs 'bras bu'o/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud la dbye na/ rgyu rgyud sngon du 'gro ba rten gyi gang zaganyams su blang bya thabs kyi rgyud/ nyams su blangs pas thob pa 'bras bu'i rgyud/ dang po la/ rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo gang zag gi rang bzhin/ rgyud de ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i snang cha 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang rgyu rgyud du bsdus pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /'khor ba rgyun du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gang zag gi rang bzhin ni/ slob dpon garbha ri pas/ rgyu rigs spang bya skyen la ltos/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes pa ltar gang zag la dbye na/ rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa ste bzhi'o/ / gsum pa de ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul la/ spyod pa'i rim pas sbyang ba/ lta ba'i rim pas sbyang ba/ dbang gis smin par byed pa ste/ ji skad du/ skal dman sems can 'dul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa ste/ de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/

/zhes gsungs so/ /de yang skal dman rim 'jug gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ skal ldan cig car pa la ni/ dbang bskur ba kho nas rgyud sbyangs pa 'grub pa yin no/ /spyir dbang la rgyu dus kyi dbang dang*/ lam dus kyi dbang dang*/ 'bras dus kyi dbang gsum du yod cing*/ de gsum ngo bo'i sgo nas thabs rgyud yin kyang*/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang ngam/ rgyu dus kyi dbang ni/ rang gang la bskur ba'i sems rgyud de rgyu rgyud khyad par rab tu byed pa'i phyir/ rgyu rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa yin no/ / de la gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sampu ṭi las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha ga zhes su brjod/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bum dbang la lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbyibs su bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin yod pa las 'dir gtso bor gyur pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor smos shing*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang dang*/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis las/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin no/ / gnyis pa ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni slob dpon gyi bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos la slob ma rjes bzung sa chog sbyang bzung ngo*/ /sta gon rnam bzhi bris zhing rgyan bkram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ste/ mngon par rtogs pa yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yin la/ rjes chog ni slar bsdu ba'i cho ga'o/

/ gnyis pa thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtog pa ni/ lam thams cad byang chub kyi lam du 'gyur ba'i phyir rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes bskyed pa rdzogs rim dang*/ rim pa gnyis brtan nas bogs 'byin pa spyod pa dang*/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba nye rgyu ā li kā li byang chub kyi sems te mchog sgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga'o/ /yi dam lha'i thugs rgyud bskul pa'i phyir bzlas pa/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma/ sku gzugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rab gnas/ las thams cad grub par bya ba'i sbyin sreg /dman pa la mos pa'i gang zag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir las rab 'byams te thun mong gi mngon par rtogs pa lnga dang*/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ste/ mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig go /de yi lta ba de la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba gnyis las/ dang po thun mong gi lta ba ni/ pha rol du phyin pa'i lta ba yin la/ de'i thos bsam gyis lta ba ni lta ba dug can yin par bzhed do/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lta ba ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba stong nyid dam/ yul can dbang gi ye shes kyis myong byar byas pa la ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /rim pa gnyis kyis rnam dag 'og tu 'chad la/ spyod pa de la/ a wa dhu ti'i kun 'dar gyi spyod pa dang/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ste gsum mo/ /nye rgyu ni spyod pa dang 'brel ba yin mod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus dbang bskur ba/ 'bras dus kyi dbang gi ye shes dang 'brel ba yin no/ /bzlas pa la sogs pa thun mong gi mngon par rtogs pa drug ni gzhan du 'chad la/ dam tshig sdom pa la dbye na bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/

bza' ba'i dam tshig gnyis su dbye ba'am/ yang na las dang po pa'i dam tshig /brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i dam tshig /brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig ste gsum mo/ /man ngag las dam tshig nyi shu'i rnam par dag pa bshad mod/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni 'di tsam mo/ /de la spyod pa dang nye rgyu ni/ rdzogs rim gyi yan lag yin la/ thun mong gi mngon par rtogs pa lnga ni/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag /rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ dam tshig ni gnyis ka la dgos pa yin no/ / des na thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig la/ rtsa ba gnyis dang yan lag dgu'o/ / gsum pa nyams su blangs pas thob pa 'bras bu'i rgyud la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sa bcu gnyis dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ / dang po la/ ngo bo ni bde stong gi ye shes yin la/ de'i rgyu ni/ phyi rol du yul chen rnams bsgrod pa dang*/ nang du rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros dbu mar thim pa yin no/ /'di'i nyams su blang bya mnyam bzhag tu bde ba chen po'i ye shes sgom pa dang*/ rjes thob tu rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pa'o/ /sa rnams kyi yon tan la thun mong gi yon tan ni/ mdo dang mtshungs shing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan rgyas par rgyud du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni sku bzhi dang ye shes lngas bsdus pa yin cing*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ yon tan 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs rgyud du shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa rim gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa la/ rim gnyis spyi'i rnam dag bstan pa dang*/ bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/ grol ba'i 'thad pa ste/ rim gnyis spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa drug go /dang po la/ ngo bo ni/ yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can te bde stong gi ye shes lha sku'i rnam pa dang 'brel

ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po la dbye na ting nge 'dzin gsum/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug go / gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la dbye na/ rang byin rlabs pa/ dkyil 'khor ro/ /gsum pa sgra don ni/ 'phags skor pa/ 'ga' zhig gi lugs la/ bskyed pa'i don ni skye ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i don 'chi ba dang*/ rim pa ni de gnyis sbyong byed la 'dod pa dang*/ dus 'khor ba kha cig gis bskyed pa'i don thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ rdzogs pa'i don mchog gi dngos grub dang*/ rim pa ni de gnyis mngon du byed pa'i lam la 'dod kyang*/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa yab sras kyi dgongs don rang lugs ni bskyed pa'i don yid rnam rtog gi rtsol bas bskyed pa'i lha sku dang*/ rdzogs pa ni lus ngag yid gsum rdzogs pa ste/ de'i don yang*/ lus rtsa/ ngag rlung dang yi ge /sems thig le rnams lus la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du rdzogs par bsgoms pa yin pas na/ gzhan du yongs su grub pa'i rim pa zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ spang bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir dang*/ thob bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir dang/ ngo bo rten brten pa'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su grangs nges so/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ tha mal gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sgom pa yang dag rab tu bsgrags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs bsgoms pa nas/ /

bsgoms pa ma yin mi bsgoms min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom pa'o/ / tha mal gyi rnam rtog de la dbye na rgyu las dang nyon mongs dang*/ 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshogs bsags rnam pa gnyis kyis sbyong bar byed cing*/ gnyis pa la snod dang bcud sbyong tshul gnyis las/ snod kyi 'jig rten ni lha'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs la ni/ lha'i gdan gyi kyang sbyong bar byed cing*/ bcud sbyong tshul la bskyed chog gi skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba dang*/ lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong ba'o/ /dang po skyed chog gi skye gnas bzhi'i sbyong tshul ni/ mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi drod gsher skyes sbyong ba dang*/ mkha' nang nas lha tshogs spro bas mngal skyes sbyong ba dang*/ 'od kyi gong bu las bzhengs pa dang*/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed kyis sgong skyes sbyong ba dang*/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzus skyes sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni spyir lha rnams zhi ba dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro chags 'dres pa gsum du 'dus shing*/ chags pa'i rnam pas 'dod chags sbyong ba dang*/ shin tu khro bo'i rnam pas zhe sdang sbyong ba dang*/ shin tu zhi ba'i rnam pas gti mug sbyong ba dang*/ khror chags 'dres pas ni/ dug gsum kha sbyong ba yin te/ de yang btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du 'dug pas 'dod chags sbyong ba dang*/ khro bo chen por 'dug pas zhe sdang sbyong ba dang*/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pas gti mug sbyong ba yin te/ des na zhi khro phyogs re ba ni mi zab pa yin la/ khro chags 'dres pa ni shin tu zab pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir du rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom pa yin te/

de skad du rtsa rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed do/ /zhes so/ /bskyed rim gyi gnas skabs su/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang bsres pas/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog cung zad mgo gnon par byed mod kyi/ gya nom lhar zhen la sogs pa rnam rtog phra mo rnams dpyis 'byin pa la rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos pa yin no/ / gnyis pa thob bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su nges pa ni/ spyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis car sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang bcas sgrub par byed pa'i thabs yin mod kyi/ gtso bor gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i don du bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /zhes gsungs zhing*/ gtso bor chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i don du rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos pa yin te/ sambu ṭi las/ rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /chos kyi sku zhes rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ngo bo rten dang brten pa'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su grang nges pa ni rtsa rgyud las ji skad du/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med gang las bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med pas/ /bde ba nyid kyang mi dmigs 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pas/ me tog dang me tog gi dri ltar/ bskyed rim gyi sgrub pa'i lha sku lus kyi chos dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po sems kyi chos gnyis rten dang brten par gnas pa yin no/

/ lnga pa go rim las/ 'phags skor ba kha cig bskyed rim brtan par byas nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos par 'dod pa dang*/ sems 'grel khag gi bskyed rim brtan rung ma brtan rung lo bcu gnyis bsgoms nas slar yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pa dang gzhan yang slob dpon kha cig bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas btab nas bsgom par 'dod pa sogs mang du yod kyang brgyud pa 'di'i lugs ni/ stan thog cig tu thun stod la bskyed rim dang thun smad la rdzogs rim bsgom par bzhed pa yin no/ / drug pa grol ba'i 'thad pa la/ rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rgyu la 'bras bu rgyas btab cing*/ /'bras bu la yang rgyu rgyas gdab zhes dang*/ rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba gzi brjid pa/ /de bzhin 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi snang cha bzhin lag la sogs snang ba ni rgyu yin la/ bskyed rim gyi lha sku bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis de'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i don du sgom pa 'thad la/ sems kyi chos nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su gnas pa ni rgyu yin cing*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bde stong bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis de'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ chos kyi sku 'grub par 'thad pa yin no/ / gnyis pa thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir/ grol ba'i 'thad pa ni/ rim pa gnyis po thams cad gnyen por che ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can yin cing*/ de yang rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba dang*/ ltog pa gnyen por che ba dang*/ sgom pa gnyen por che ba dang*/ brtan pa gnyen po che ba ste/

bzhir bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed cing*/ dang po ni/ dug gis khyad par gyis dug nad zhi ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ mon sran tre'u'i bza' bas rlung nad zhi ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ chu thigs rna bar zhugs pa chu gzhan gyis dgug pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ mes tshig pa la me nyid kyis gdung ba las sel ba lta bu ste/ rnam rtog khyad par gyis rnam rtog 'joms pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam pa can gyis nyon mongs pa 'joms pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ste/ zlog sgom gyi grol bar 'thad pa yin no/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ji ltar rlung gi zin pa de/ /mon sran tri'u'i bza' ba sbyin/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas mu stegs kyi mi shes/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs so/ /gsum pa dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ grol ba'i 'thad pa ni/ ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud las/ nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re'i dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /zhes dang*/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /zhes pa ltar/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa dang*/ lha so so'i dag pa dang*/ rang rig pa'i dag pa ste gsum las/ spyir rim pa gnyis kar la dag pa gsum char tshang yod/ gtso bor chos thams cad gdod ma nas spros pa dang bral ba ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag par gnas la de'i phyir/ rtogs pa'i lta bas de nyid stong nyid du bsgoms pas grol bar 'thad pa dang*/ phung khams skye mched gdod ma nas lha so so'i dag par gnas la/ de'i phyir bskyed rim gyis de dag lha skur bsgoms pas grol bar 'thad pa dang*/ sems nyid rang rig pa'i bde ba chen po/ rang rig pa'i dag par gnas la/ de'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa bde stong goms pas grol bar 'thad pa yin no/

/ gnyis pa bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa la/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ gang gis sgom pa'i gang zag /gang gi tshe sgom pa'i dus/ ji ltar sgom pa'i bsam pa/ bsgom bya dngos zhib mor bshad pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du rtsa rgyud las/ gnas ni bzang po nges par brtags/ /rang gi khyim du mtshan dus su/ /zhes pa ltar/ las dang po pas/ rang gi khyim du sgom pa dang*/ brtan pa cung zad thob pas ni/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ma mo'i khyim nang mtshan mo dang*/ /yang na dben pa'i bas mtha' ru/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gnas dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pas ni yul chen sum cu so bdun rnams su sgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dir/ dbang bkur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa/ las dang po pa'i sa la gnas pa yin no/ /gsum pa gang gi tshe sgom pa'i dus ni/ gong du smos pa/ mtshan dus su zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las dang po pas/ bskyed rim gyi lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'i dus/ gtso bor mtshan mo yin la lhag ma bzlas sgom la sogs pa bya ba'i dus la nges pa med do/ /brtan pa cung zad thob nas gnas skabs thams cad sgom par bya ba yin te/ ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan pa'i sems kyi skad cig kyang*/ /gdug pa'i sems ni ma rig pas/ /dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir/ /mkhas pas 'bad pas mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ / bzhi pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag nyid grub pa'i sems kyi ni/ /rnal 'byor ma sgom shes rab can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam dang lam ston pa po'i gang zag la/ the tshom spangs nas nges par 'grub pa'i yid chos dang bcas te sgom dgos pa yin no/ / lnga pa la bsgom bya dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag dang*/ sgom tshul mngon rtogs kyi rnam bzhag dang*/ sgom 'bras sa lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa gsum las/

dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud dang bcas pa rnams las dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag mang du gsungs mod/ 'dir gur brtag sam gsum las bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag ni/ dngos bstan tshig gi zin pa bla ma'i man ngag gi bkral ba gnyis las dang po dngos ni brtag gnyis las/ sku kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsung kyai rdo rje dang*/ thugs kyi kyai rdo rje ste/ thun mong he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ snying po kyai rdo rje dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor te/ mchog gi dkyil 'khor gnyis re lnga'o/ / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur las ni/ mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor te rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lnga dang*/ rigs bsdus la ni/ brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha dgu ma lnga gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha lnga ma lnga gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ste/ rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor gnyis so/ /de dag la ji skad du/ sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor gang gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ lha gtso bo lnga go 'phos pa'i dbye bas rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga bsdus pa lnga ste/ snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga/ bdag med lha mo bcu gsum ma dang*/ bco lnga ma ste/ dngos bstan tshig gis zin pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bdun dang*/ he ru ka gzhan gsum gyi sgrub thabs gnyis dngos su bshad pa la rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis bzhed pas/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs sbyar bas/

dngos bstan dkyil 'khor nyi shur gsungs so/ /sambu ṭi las/ sku he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsung gi he ru ka thugs kyi he ru ka /snying po'i he ru ka rnams la/ lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor re re gsung zhing*/ rdo rje bdag med ma dang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rtog gdan can lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor re dngos bstan tshig gis zin pa brgyad do/ / 'di'i bdag med ma ni/ slob dpon a bha ya ka ras lha nyi shu rtsa gsum du gsungs kyang*/ rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma ni/ lha bco lnga mar bzhed do/ / gnyis pa la rgya bod kyi mkhas pa so so'i 'dod tshul la mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir ma smos la/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i man ngag gi lugs la rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsnan pa la drug go / bshad rgyud rdo rje gur las byung ba la ni/ snying po kyai rdo rje rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la rigs lnga'i dbye bas/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang*/ bsdus pa lnga 'byung bzhin du/ he ru ka gzhan gsum la rigs lnga'i dbye bas/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang*/ bsdus pa lnga ste bcu bcu 'byung bas rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu dang*/ dngos bstan snying po kyai rdo rje rigs rkyang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la rigs lnga'i dbye bas/ rigs rkyang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor lnga yod pa bzhin du/ he ru ka gzhan gsum la yang rigs lnga'i dbye bas rigs kyang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor lnga lnga 'byung bas nyi shu'o/ /de ltar yab he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor drug cu'i steng du bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis te/ drug cu rtsa gnyis ljon shing las bshad pa ltar ram/

yang gur rgyan ltar na/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi steng du/ rigs rkyang lha lnga la nyi shu bstan pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ de yang brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ zhes pa'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ rigs rkyang dang rigs bsdus gnyis 'byung ba bzhin du/ yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbang zhes pa'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor la yang rigs rkyang dang rigs bsdus kyi dbye ba don gyis thob pas/ yab he ru ka bzhi la rigs lnga'i dbye bas nyi shu la lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor re re ste dkyil 'khor nyi shu'o/ /rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor la/ rgyas pa nyi shu/ bsdus pa nyi shu/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la rgyas pa nyi shu/ bsdus pa nyi shu/ yab kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor brgyad cu la/ sku gsung thugs snying po'i he ru ka bzhi la dkyil 'khor nyi shu nyi shu 'byung zhing*/ rigs lnga la/ dkyil 'khor bcu drug bcu drug yod do/ / 'dir nye bar mkho ba mi bskyod pa rdo rje can gyi kyai rdo rje rnams ming gi rnam grangs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sangs rgyas rtag pa phan pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ rdo rje nyi ma gser gyi rigs/ he ru ka'i rigs nam mkha' mdzod/ ces pa rnam grangs dang*/ 'od dpag med/ padma gar dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje chos rnams rnam grangs dang*/ don yod grub pa dang*/ rta'i rgyal po/ rdo rje rta mchog /'dun pa'i rgyal po lcags kyi rgyal po rnam grangs so/ /sambu ṭi las/ dkyil 'khor dang po bdun gyi steng du/ rdo rje dbyings la rigs lnga'i lha gtso bor go 'phos pa'i dbye bas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga ste bcu gnyis so/ /de dag la he ru ka bzhi dang*/ bdag med ma ni kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma ni rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ drag po gdan can dang*/ rdo rje dbyings ni sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang mthun par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/

slob dpon a bha ya ka ras ni/ drag po gdan can ston pa'i tshig gis dur khrod la dgyes pa'i he ru ka dang*/ drag po gdan can gnyis ston par bzhed cing*/ de gnyis dang rdo rje dbyings ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhed do/ /de ltar yongs su dril bas kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum las dngos bstan/ mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis bkral bas brgya tham par 'gyur ro/ / las rgyas pa ni/ brtag gnyis las ku ru kulle dang*/ lha mo bdun gyi lha sngags tsam gsungs shing*/ rdo rje gur las ni/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ las tshogs rgyas pa gsungs/ lhag ma las rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa bdun dang*/ las tshogs ci rigs pa mdor bsdus pa gsungs so/ /sumbha ṭi las ni/ las rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ las tshogs shin tu rgyas par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sgom tshul mngon rtogs kyi rim pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa yan lag drug pa nyid rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi chings rnam par dbye ba'o/ /dang po la/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bo bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa dang/ zhar las byung ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po ni gzhung la dngos su ma gsungs kyang bla ma'i man ngag yin la/ spyir skyabs su song ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gnyis ma zad/ thun re'i mgor yang de nyid gsal gdab dgos pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib rags pa dag pa'i phyir du/ yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas kyang byed dgos pas de gsum mo/

/he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas bshags tshig dang bcas pa'i 'di bde mchog gis bshad rgyud la a bhi dha na las 'byung ba yin cing*/ 'di bla med kyi dkyil 'khor phal cher la 'jug pa yin no/ / 'di skabs kyi rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ yan lag bzhi bskyed kyi chogs bskyed pa mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin te/ 'di mngon rtogs rgyas pa gzhan la ltos pa lha'i bskyed chog nyi tshe ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dper na mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma bskyed pa bzhin nam/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i bzhed pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha gang sgrub kyang*/ / mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi bskyed dgos gsungs pa ni/ mngon rtogs rang dbang can gyi dbang du byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ tshogs bsags pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dang po la/ yul mchog la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ yul dman pa bsags pa gnyis las/ dang po la rten byin gyis brlabs pa/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ tshogs bsags pa dngos dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ tha mal gyi nga rgyal gyi mchod pa la sogs pa byas pa la yang bsod nams kyi tshogs che bar 'byung mod/ de lta bus bskul bas mchod pa las kyang*/ dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur nas nyin zhag gcig gi bar du mchod pa bsod nams che bas/ lus lha sku dang*/ sems gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes kyi ngo bo ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i hūṃ gis rnam par sgom pa yin no/ / gnyis pa gang nas spyan 'dren pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas ni/ 'ga' zhig ltar 'og min stug po bkod par 'chad pa'ang mi 'gal mod/ 'dir chos dbyings nyid yin pas 'gro 'ong gi rnam pa mi dgos shing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab pa kho nas chog la/ de yang bla ma dang yi dam ngo bo dbyer med pa la thams cad mthun mod/

'dir rnam pa tha dad pa ni/ bla ma nyid yi dam gyi rigs bdag gi tshul du gsal gdab dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags sdom bzung ste bzhi las/ 'dir mchod pa ni snying ga'i hūṃ las spros pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis 'bul ba yin la/ lha mo dang po lngas nang gi mchod pa dang*/ brgyad pa g.yung mos ni gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba yin no/ /gnyis pa yul dman pa la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi sgom pa yin zhing*/ dang po gsum ni theg pa spyi dang mthun la/ bzhi pa ni sems can thams cad btang snyoms tshad med pa la 'god par 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bzhi 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su skye ba phyi mar skye 'gyur gyi 'phen byed kyi las gsog pa dang mtshungs pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras dang sbyar na bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dngamatshungs pa yin la/ de gnyis dang mtshungs par sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni/ lam de ltar bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams sbyong ba dang*/ 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de ltar sgom pa'i gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni lha rnams mchod pas mnyes shing rgyud byin rlabs pa dang*/ des bar du gcod pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ tshogs chung ngus tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye ba'i rgyur gyur ba'o/ / gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs so so nas bshad pa ltar/ rnam thar bzhi dang*/ gsum dang*/ dag pa gsum dang*/ snang ba sems dang*/ sems stong nyid du gtan la 'bebs pa ste rim gnyis kyis sbyor tshul sogs mang du gsungs mod kyang*/ 'dir shu n+ya ta'i sogs sngags don bsam pa gcig pus chog la/ slob dpon 'ga' zhig ltar rig pa'i dpyad pa sngon du gtong ba dang mi 'gal mod/ 'dir stong pa nyid la mi rtog par 'jog pa ste/

stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ stong nyid rig pa'i myong byar byas pa ste/ de'i rjes thob kyi tshul du sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes nga rgyal yang bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la 'chi ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pas sbyong zhing*/ 'bras bu'i chos la/ yang dag pa'i mtha' chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i rnam pa dang mthun pas lam du byed pa yin no/ /'dir ye shes tshogs gsog 'chi ba sbyong byed du mi 'thad par 'dod pa ni/ mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud ma mthong bar zad la/ kha cig bsrung 'khor yan chad sngon 'gro'i chos la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba 'gog pa ni/ rang gis kyang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la ye shes tshogs bsags 'chi ba sbyong byed du bshad pa dang nang 'gal ba yin no/ / gnyis pa bsrungaba'i 'khor lor sgom pa la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ 'di'i rigs 'dra bla med kyi dkyil 'khor phal cher la/ thun mong du 'jug pa'i don yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bsrung 'khor 'di'i rigs 'dra dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'jug pa ma yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor khyad par can 'ga' zhig la yod ces pa'i don yin no/ /'di'i kyai rje'i thun mong ma yin pa la 'chad pa mi 'thad de/ kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin yang khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor med pa mang zhing*/ rgyud sde gzhan gyis dkyil 'khor la yang khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor bsgom dgos pa mang du yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong gi bsrung 'khor la rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan las nyi ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje'i rwa gur re bzhir bshad pa dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag las/ padma rdo rje'i sa gzhi drwa ba/ bla re/ me ri dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun par sbyar ba yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor ni/ rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel rnams las sna tshogs par gsungs na yang*/

bla ma'i man ngag gis rdo rje gur las gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur ba'i/ las tshogs phyir bzlog gi skabs kyi 'khor lo la/ bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs dang bsrung ba'i skabs kyi khro bo gzhan bcu pa bkod pa yin cing*/ de la'ang bsrung ba tsam dang phyir bzlog gnyis las bsrung ba tsam gyis phyir bzlog mi grub cing*/ phyir bzlog gis ni gnyis car grub pa yin no/ /da lta'i lag len ni/ phyir bzlog gi cho ga'o/ khro bo bcu'i gnas dang*/ yan lag bzhi bskyed dgos pas phyir bzlog gi gnas lnga'i gzhi legs pa yod pa rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pas/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la gang du skye ba len par 'gyur ba'i bar du gcod pa sel ba mtshon zhing*/ 'bras bu'i chos la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i sngon rol tu/ bdud kyi sde bcom pa'i mtshon pa yin no/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i bya ba la/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa dang*/ lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas/ ji skad du/ pho brang sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ dbang ni mi bskyod de bzhin gshegs/ / bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan dpal/ / mchod pa don yod rang bzhin mchod/ /rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos/ / zhes pa ltar pho brang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag /rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lagabadud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag /mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag te drug las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas gzhi sgrub nas ni/ /zhes pa ltar gyi gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yin te/ de la gzhi'i yan lag chos 'byung*/

rgyu'i yan lag 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa*/ rkyen gyi yan lag bar do sbyong byed 'jog cing bar do'i rnam par shes pa bsre ba/ ngo bo'i yan lag gzhal yas khang dngos bskyed pa'o/ /'dir chos 'byung ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang bstun na nam mkha' mtshon pa dang*/ 'bras bu 'grub pa dang bstun na chos kyi dbyings dri ma med par gyur pa mtshon pa yin no/ /'byung ba bzhi la gzhal yas khang 'grub pa bzhin du/ lha mo bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ 'byung ba bzhi las snod chags pa dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i zhing khams mtshon pa yin no/ / 'dir 'byung ba bzhi po/ rtsa rgyud las/ gtso bor lugs ldog dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ gtso bor lugs 'byung du sgom pa bdun gang ltar yang mi 'gal ba yin la/ gzhal yas khang gi rgyur 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ de nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon yin cing*/ gzhal yas khang rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor byed pas yin no/ /kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs tshad dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig las/ bar do mtshon byed 'jog pa med cing*/ 'ga' zhig la yod kyang*/ nang sgom pa la sogs pa yod la/ 'dir grub chen ḍom bi he ru ka'i dgongs don/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las/ yi ge lnga bkod pa gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs mthun par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i yi ge 'bru gsum gyis bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum mtshon pa dang*/ ho gnyis kyi skye ba len pa'i rgyu sred pa len pa mtshon no/ /sbyang 'bras la sbyar na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ dbyings dang ye shes mtshon/ sems kyi snang cha 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la bsres pas gzhal yas khang lha sku'i ngo bor 'gyur zhing*/ de nyid rang gi sems kyi snang bar shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sems can kyi las kyi mthu las snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang zhing sbyangs pas dag pa'i zhing khams grub pa bzhin du/

yi ge 'bru lnga'i rnam pa can gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mthu las/ gzhal yas khang 'grub pa yin te/ sems cha gcig bsres pa'i dag sbyor gyi phyogs gcig ni 'di yang yin no/ /de ltar na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul dkyus ltar na phrugs gcig ni de tsam yin la gzhan yang gzhal yas khang gi lus sbyong ba dang*/ lha skus sems sbyong ba ltar na/ mngal du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang bstun nas/ 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung dang*/ mngal du gnas pa'i tshe/ 'byung ba bzhis phan btags pa ltar/ lugs ldog tu sgom pa yin/ de ltar 'byung bzhi las lus 'grub pa dang mtshungs pa/ de las gzhal yas khang 'grub pa'o/ / sems snang cha cig bsre ba yang*/ bar do'i rnam shes 'jug pa nyid yin pas sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sbyong tshul phyi ma gnyis ni slob dpon birwa pa dang*/ ḍom bhi pa'i man ngag la med kyang*/ pham thing pa yab sras kyi man ngag ltar bla ma rnams skabs 'dir gsungs pa bzhin bshad pa yin no/ /lha'i gdan bskyed pa yang gzhal yas khang sgom pa'i yan lag yin cing*/ sngags kyi nga rgyal ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor shes pa'i ched dang*/ yan lag drug gi sa mtshams shes pa'i ched kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/ rdo rje gur las/ kun tu bzang po bden pa'i dngos/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom bya ste/ /rang rang lhag lha'i sgrub thabs bya/ /zhes pa ltar dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mdzad pa/ zhu ba glu yis bskul ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa/ 'od zer spro bsdus zhing sbyong ba/ yi ge 'god cing byin rlabs te drug las/ dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin cing*/ de yang mngon byang dang po bzhi dang*/

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs bzhin pa ni mngon byang lnga pa min la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs zin pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /de la mngon byang lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa cung zad bshad pa la/ rgyud gzhung las ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul dang*/ mngon byang gi dag bya bshad pa dang*/ de'i 'phros don cung zad bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud thams cad la/ thun mong du sbyar bar bya ba ni de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs te/ de yang sems so sor rtog pa las mngon par byang chub pa/ byang chub kyi sems las mngon par byang chub pa/ brtan pa'i rdo rje las mngon par byang chub pa/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid las mngon par byang chub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ji lta ba de lta bu las/ mngon par byang chub pa ste lnga'o/ /gsang 'dus 'phags skor pa'i lugs la ni/ de bzhin nyid las mngon par byang chub pa/ zla ba las mngon par byang chub pa/ yi ge las mngon par byang chub pa/ mtshan ma las mngon par byang chub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las mngon par byang chub pa dang lngar gsungs la/ lhag ma bla med kyi rgyud sde phal cher las/ nyi zla kha sbyor dang zla ba kha sbyor sogs khyad par phran tshegs ma gtogs don gyi spyi mthun par gsungs pa yin no/ /

gnyis pa la sbyong byed bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga bshad pa/ sbyang bya 'khor ba'i skye ba bshad pa/ sbyang 'bras 'bras bu'i mngon byang bshad pa'o/ / dang po la/ bsdus pa ā li kā li la ma ltos pa'i mngon byang dang*/ rgyas pa ā li kī li la ltos pa'i mngon byang gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud las/ de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon yin/ /phyi nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan cing*/ 'di mi mnyam sbyor kho nar nges so/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mngon byang la mi mnyam sbyor dang mnyam sbyor gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyi gnas/ kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma 'dus pa las/ /dkar po la sogs rab tu grags/ / zhes gsungs/ rgyud gsum po'i gong 'og phal cher las 'di nyid gtso bor bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mnyam sbyor gyi mngon byang ni/ kyai rdo rje'i skabs 'dir brgyud pa 'di brgyud pa 'di kho nas bzhed pa'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud/ ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu las/ /hūṃ phaṭa rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ /zhes pas zur tsam bstan pa yin cing*/ rgyas par sambu ṭi'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas 'byung bas kha skong ba yin no/ /de yang mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi skabs su zla ba gru gsum dkar po kha sbyor dang*/ mngon byang gsum pa ni/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dkar po kho nar nges shing*/ sa bon gyi mtshan pa med pa dang*/ mngon byang bzhi pa la 'od zer spro bsdus zhing sbyong ba yod pa ni 'di'i khyad par yin no/ /kyai rdor ba gzhan rnams ni/ gzhung tshig nges kyang nyi zla kha sbyor nyid bstan pa dang*/ sumbu ṭir zla ba kha sbyor du bshad pa ni/

rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor kho na dbang du byas pa dang*/ de'i zla ba yang zlum por 'dod do/ /de ltar bskyed chog gi rnam par dag pa de dag la bskyed bya lha'i sgo nas gtso bo kho na mngon byang las bskyed pa dang*/ gtso 'khor thams cad mngon byang las bskyed pa gnyis so/ / gnyis pa sbyang bya 'khor ba'i skye ba bshad pa ni/ brgyud pa 'di'i snga rabs pa rnams kyi gsung kho na ltar na/ mngon byang gi zla bas brdzus skyes kyi sems kyi gsal cha dang*/ drod gsher skyes kyi gsher ba dang*/ mngal skyes kyi pha'i khams rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /nyi mas ni brdzus skyes kyi gnas la sred pa dang*/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod dang mngal skyes kyi ma'i khams rnams sbyong bar byed cing*/ nyi zla gnyis char gyis kyang sgong skyes kyi sgo nga'i khyim dang bcud sbyong bar byed do/ /zhes pa de tsam zhig gsungs la/ mngon byang phyi ma gsum 'og tu 'chad pa dang 'dra'o/ / rang lugs kyi bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar na/ de nyid skye gnas gzhan gsum la gtso bor mi sbyor zhing*/ mngal skyes kho na la gtso bor sbyor bar mang de yang slob dpon gzhan gyi man ngag gis kha skang nas zhib mor 'chad pa yin no/ /de la zla bas ni mngal skyes kyi lus 'grub pa'i rgyu/ pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po mtshon pa yin cing*/ de nyid zla ba yar ngo dang mar ngo la 'char ba thig le 'pho ba bcu drug ste/ dbyangs yig sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bor gnas pa yin la/ de dang mthun pa'i ā li phrag gnyis sgom pa yin no/ /nyi mas ni ma'i rakta mtshon pa yin cing*/ de'i tshogs pa la ni sa chu me rlung nam mkha' de khams lnga yod pa/ de re re la gang na gcig yod pa der thams cad kyang ngo zhes pa'i rim pas 'byung ba bzhi bzhir phye bas nyi shu 'byung la/ de re re la brten thig le lus kyi chos dang*/ rten pa bde ba chen po sems kyi chos gnyis gnyis te bzhi bcu 'byung zhing*/

de re re la'ang snang ba'i cha dang*/ stong pa'i cha gnyis gnyis te brgyad cu mtshon pa'i phyir du kā li brgyad cu bsgom par bya ba'o/ / mngon byang gsum pa'i skabs kyi sa bon ni/ skye srid kyi shes pa rlung dang bcas pa mtshon cing*/ gnas skabs des ni dkar dmar sems gsum 'dres pa'i gnas skabs mtshon pa yin la/ phyag mtshan mngal du lus 'phel ba'i yan lag dang*/ nying lag dang dbang po rnams dod pa mtshon no/ /mngon byang bzhi pa'i thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ mngal du grub pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams yongs su smin cing gong nas gong du 'phel ba mtshon no/ /lnga pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ mngal nas btsas pa na/ bzhin lag yongs su rdzogs pa mngon gyur gzhan la snang du rung ba mtshon pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ 'bras bu'i mngon byang dngos bshad pa dang*/ de nyid bskyed rim la sbyor ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la mngon par byang chub pa'i 'char tshul dang*/ de nyid kyi ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar te/ de yang mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od dang 'grogs pa na dga' ba skad c-ig ma dang po dang*/ nyin mo nyi ma'i 'od dang 'grogs pa ni/ mchog dga' skad cig ma gnyis pa dang*/ nyi ma nub pa na mtshams kyi mun pas khyab pa khyad dga' skad cig ma gsum pa dang*/ tho rangs skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su lhan cig skyes dga' skad cig ma bzhi pa rnams mngon du byas nas/ skad cig ma lnga pa la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yin la/ de lta bu'i phyi'i mngon byang ni/ pha rgyud las gsungs pa dang thun mong ba yin no/ /nang byang chub sems kyi bgrod pa la ltos pa'i mngon byang ni/ sangs rgya kha ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba de'i tshe/

rgyun mtha'i snga logs su bum dbang gsang dbang sngon du 'gro bas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rang snang gi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa thabs kyi dkar cha byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas/ gsang ba'i bar du 'ongs shing bstan par byas pas yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi ye shes skye ba mngon byang dang po yin la/ de lta bu'i dkar cha dang lhan cig rang snang gi rig ma'i dmar cha ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i gtsug tu brtan par byas pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi ye shes skye ba te mngon byang gnyis pa yin no/ /de nas slob ma'i ye shes kyi snang bar gyur par rlung dang bcas pa'i tshogs pa phra mo rnams snying gar thim zhing*/ de'i rkyen gyis thig le dkar dmar gyi tshogs pa 'babs pa ni mngon byang gsum pa yin no/ /rkyen de'i skad cig ma gnyis pa las dga' ba bzhi par gyur pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes dngos skye ste/ ye shes de ni bde chen gyi sgrib pa'am/ shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo dang*/ kun gzhi spong bar byed pa'i dngos gnyen te/ mngon byang bzhi pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mngon byang dang po gnyis ni yas brtan dang mas brtan gyis bsdus pa dga' ba bzhi bzhi'i bdag nyid can yin cing*/ mngon byang gsum pa ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes bla na med pa yin no/ /mngon byang bzhi pa ni rang bzhin lhan skyes su gyur pa'i lam gyi ye shes mthar thug yin pas/ de nyid lhan cig skyes dga' 'ba' zhig gis bsdus pa yin la/ mngon byang dang po bzhi go rim bzhin du dga' ba bzhi dang sbyar ba yang yod pa ni/ de rnams lus dang ngag dang yid dang*/ ye shes kyi bde ba yin pas/ rnam pa mtshungs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /mngon byang bzhi pa de'i skad cig gnyis par sangs rgyas kyi ye shes skye ba yin la/ de yang mi slob rnam grol lam ni mngon byang lnga pa'i bdag nyid yin cing*/

skad cig gnyis pa phan chad mngon byang lnga char gyi bdag nyid du gnas so/ /zhes bla ma rnams gsungs so/ /des na mngon byang dang po bzhi ni/ ye shes lnga gar rjes mthun gyi ngor gnas la mngon byang lnga pa ni ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid dngos su gnas pa yin no/ /de yang chos thams cad kyi ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i gnas lugs mkhyen pa dang*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs shing dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po ni 'jug pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma 'dres par mkhyen pa dang*/ sems can gyi khams tha dad pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i rgyu nus mthu'i ngo bor gnas pa thugs rje chen po'i ye shes dang*/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med par gnas pa la glo bur gyi dri ma byang ba'i ye shes te/ go rim bzhin du me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnams kyi ngo bo yin no/ / yang sbyor tshul gzhan gyi mngon byang dang po'i skabs su/ me long lta bu'i ye shes thob nas mngon byang lnga pa'i tshe/ chos dbyings ye shes thob pa'i bar du gsungs pa/ dang po bzhi la rjes mthun pa dang/ lnga pa la dngos yin no/ /de ltar mngon byang dang po bzhi snga ma snga ma'i ye shes lhag par rgyas pa/ phyi ma phyi ma la yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul du yod cing*/ ye shes rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas na/ mngon byang dngapo'i skabs su me long ye shes gco bor gyur pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i skabs su mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ gsum pa'i skabs su so sor rtog pa'i ye shes gtso bor gyur pa dang/ bzhi pa'i skabs su bya ba grub pa'i ye shes gtso bor gyur pa yin no/ /de dag tu chos kyi dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan mthar thug ma thob pa'i phyir/ chos dbyings ye shes gtso bor mi 'jog la/

mngon byang lnga pa'i skabs su ni de gsar du thob pa'i de'i phyir gtso bor 'jog pa yin no/ / gnyis pa de nyid bskyed rim la sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ bskyed rim gyi mngon byang dang po zla ba bsgom pa ni/ 'bras dus kyi mngon byang dang po dang mtshungs pa yin te/ zla bas ni byang chub kyi sems dkar po mtshon la/ mngon byang dang po ni/ byang chub kyi sems dkar cha dang 'grogs pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ / bskyed rim gyi mngon byang gnyis pa nyi ma bsgoms pa ni/ 'bras dus kyi gnyis pa dang mtshungs pa yin te/ nyi ma'i khams dmar cha mtshon la/ mngon byang gnyis pa ni/ rten byang chub kyi sems dmar cha dang 'grogs pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ /bskyed rim gyi mngon byang gsum pa sa bon dang phyag mtshan bsgom pa ni/ 'bras dus kyi mngon byang gsum pa dang mtshungs pa yin te/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyis ni/ yid rlung gi tshogs pa dang bcas pa mtshon pa yin cing*/ 'bras dus kyi mngon byang gsum pa ni/ yid lung thim pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ / mngon byang bzhi pa yang rnam pa mtshungs pa yin te/ skabs 'dir thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ 'bras dus kyi mngon byang bzhi pa yang*/ mngon byang dang po gsum char gyi nus pa gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ / mngon byang lnga pa yang rnam pa mtshungs pa yin te/ skabs 'dir bskyed chog gi cho ga la brten nas lha sku yongs su rdzogs pa yin zhing*/ 'bras dus kyi mngon lnga pa dang/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs thams cad rdzogs pa yin pas so/ / mngon byang dang po/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang rnam pa mtshungs pa yin te/ zla ba'i 'od zer gyis gzugs can rags pa tsam snang bar byed pa ltar/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa'i chos rnams kyis gnas lugs gzigs pa tsam yin la so sor rtog par mi 'dzad pas so/ / mngon byang gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mtshungs te/

nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer lhag par rgyas pa bzhin du/ de yang chos rnams kyi ji lta ba gnas lugs la mkhyen pa lhag par rgyas pas so/ /mngon byang gsum pa sor rtog ye shes dang mtshungs te/ skabs 'dir lha so so'i sa bon dang phyag mtshan so sor nges shing*/ sor rtog ye shes kyis chos rnams kyi/ rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa byed pas so/ /mngon byang bzhi pa bya grub ye shes dang mtshungs pa yin te/ skabs 'dir thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ sgrub bya ye shes ye shes de ye shes gzhan gsum gyi nus mthu gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ngo bor gnas pas so/ /mngon byang lnga pa chos dbyings ye shes dang mtshungs pa yin te/ skabs 'dir nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan bzhi'i ngo bo lha'i skur rdzogs pa yin cing*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyang*/ ye shes bzhi char gyi brten byed pas so/ /mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi skabs su/ ā li kā li 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan 'bras bu'i chos dang sbyar ba ni/ ā li mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ kā li dpe byad brgyad cu'i bsod nams kyi tshogs yin zhing de'i 'bras bu sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtshan dpe'i spras pa'o/ /mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi skabs su ā li kā li 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ā li zla ba'i sa bon dang*/ kā li nyi ma'i sa bon yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa de'i 'phros don cung zad bshad pa la/ mnyam sbyor la yang*/ zla ba gnyis pa ni rgyu kā li las skyes pa dang*/ zla ba gnyis mtshon pa'i 'od zer nyi ma dang phyogs mtshungs pas/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed tshul mtshungs pa yin no/ /'on kyang dag ldan las/ mnyam sbyor gsang dbang dang mi mnyam sbyor shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang mtshungs tshul gsal bar bstan nas/ dbyings dang ye shes rgyas gdab phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rgyu 'bras phyir/

/thig le rim phyir lus sems phyir/ /dbang phyir dgos pa bsam byas phyir/ /zhes mnyam sbyor gyi mtshon don sdom gyi tshul gyis gsungs pa yin te/ de'i don bar skabs kyi bla ma rnams 'di ltar 'chad de/ dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan zla ba kha sbyor gyis mtshon zhing*/ ye shes rnam pa sna tshogs 'char ba/ zla ba dkar po dang*/ nyi ma dmar po ste nyi ma zla ba kha sbyor gyis mtshon rang bzhin dag pa'i rgyu rdzogs rim rang byin rlabs pa la/ shes pa gsal stong zla ba lta bu dang*/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba byang chub kyi sems zla ba lta bu ste kha sbyor dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la rang gi byang chub kyi sems dkar cha dang/ shes rab ma'i dmar cha mtshon pa'i phyir nyi zla kha sbyor gyi mtshon no/ /pha'i sa bon 'ba' zhig las lus 'grub pa dang mtshungs par zla ba kha sbyor dang*/ pha ma'i thig le dkar dmar gnyis las lus 'grub pa dang mtshungs par nyi zla kha sbyor sgom pa dang*/ sems rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa'i lam gyis dag par byed pa zla ba kha sbyor dang*/ mngal skyes kyi lus 'grub pa dang mtshungs par nyi zla kha sbyor sgom pa yin no/ /dbang phyir zhes pa ni gong du smos pa ltar te/ de yang gsang dbang gi skabs su gang la bskur ba'i yul slob ma'i rten byang chub kyi sems dkar po dang*/ bskur byed kyi rdzas slob dpon gyi byang chub kyi sems dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ zla ba kha sbyor dang de'i tshe rnam rtog gi grwa zur dwangs pa'i phyir de nyid gru gsum dang byang chub kyi sems mi gsal ba'i mtshon don du/ /gsum pa'i tshe phyag mtshan sa bon gyi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'phro ba'i mtshon don du 'od zer spro bsdus byed pa yin no/ /

shes rab dbang gi skabs su slob ma'i byang chub kyi sems dkar po dang*/ rig ma'i byang chub kyi sems dmar po gnyis kyi mtshan don du nyi zla kha sbyor dang*/ de'i tshe rnam rtog gi grwa zur nyams pas gnyis ka'ang zlum por sgom pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dgag pa'i mtshon don du phyag mtshan gyi lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang*/ mas brtan gyi rim pas byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pas/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mi byed pa nyid do/ / dgos pa bsam yas phyir zhes pa ni de dag la sbyang bya sbyong byed sbrang 'bras sogs gzhan yang yod zhes pa'i don de gong du bshad pa ltar yin no/ / yang thig le rim phyir lus sems phyir/ /zhes pa rgyu rgyud la sbyar ba dang*/ dbang phyir zhes pa smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ rang bzhin gyis dag rgyu 'bras phyir/ / zhes pa grol byed kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ dbyings dang ye shes rgyas gdab phyir/ /zhes pa 'bras rgyud la sbyar ba yin no/ /bskyed rim gzhan la sbyor mi dgos te/ dmigs pa lnga po 'di nyid bskyed rim dngos yin pa'i phyir/ da dung de dag la mtha' cung zad bcad dgos pa 'ga' yod na'ang*/ re zhig bzhag go / gnyis pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mdzad pa la/ rten mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rgyu sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dgug pa dang*/ ngo bo 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba ste gsum las/ dang po gnyis go sla zhing sgrub thabs kyi dkyus ltar yin la/ gsum pa la/ spyir 'khor gyi lha mo spro tshul yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs la 'khor thams cad kyang mngon byang lnga bskyed yin zhing*/ mkha' nang nas thig le spro ba'i tshul dang*/ sa bon spro tshul gnyis yod pas/ de gnyis kyi phyi rol tu lha mo rnams skyed chog gi cho ga la brten nas bskyed pa yin no/ / yan lag drug pa'i phyogs la mkha' nang nas yi ge spro ba'i tshul dang*/ yi ge rnams lha mor gyur nas phyi rol tu spro ba'i tshul gnyis las/

'dir mngon rtogs kyi dkyus ni phyi ma ltar yin la/ gang ltar yang de rnams cig car du spro zhing rim gyis gsal 'deb pa yin no/ / de dag las mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ pha ma 'dod pa'i kun sbyor la zhugs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'dod chags chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa mtshon pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dgug pa ni/ skye ba po nyid mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sprul pa'i sku sprul pa'i rgyu bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/ mtshon pa yin no/ /'khor gyi lha mo spro ba ni/ lus can rnams skye ba blang nas rang gi bya ba la gnas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed pa mos pa yin no/ /gsum pa zhu ba glus bskul ba la/ bar do'i rnam par shes pa gzhug pa/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin la yab yum zhu ba/ lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul ba dang gsum las/ dang po go sla zhing*/ gnyis pa ni/ yab yum gnyis rjes chags kyi sems kyi zhu ba ste/ de yang mngon byang lnga bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar rjes chags kyi yan lag yin kyang*/ rjes chags kyi gtso bor rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhu ba nyid yin pas/ sngags kyi nga rgyal bzung ba skabs 'dir brjod dgos pa yin no/ / gsum pa lha mo bzhis bskul ba ni/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i pukka sī sogs mtshams kyi lha mos zhes tshigs su bcad pa re res bskul ba yin te/ de yang rim pa bzhin du/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas dang*/ gnad la bor ba'i sgo nas dang*/ rab tu bskul ba'i sgo nas dang*/ thugs shes pa'i sgo nas bskul ba yin no/ /de dag las bar do'i rnam shes gzhug pa ni/ bar srid kyi sems can skye gnas la dmigs nas 'jug pa dang/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro ba'i don gyi dus mkhyen pa mtshon pa dang*/

yab yum zhu ba ni mngal du srog chags pa dang*/ 'gro don gyi rgyu thugs rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bde ba chen po'i ye shes su gnas pa dang mtshungs pa yin zhing*/ glus bskul ba ni/ mngal du chags pa nas rgyu khu khrag 'dres pa la yod pa'i 'byung ba bzhi dang grogs ma'i mngal gyis 'byung ba bzhi sas sra bar byed/ chus sdud par byed/ mes smin par byed/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa dang*/ tshad med bzhis thugs rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bskul ba mtshon pa yin no/ / bzhi pa 'bras bus rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa ni/ yan lag bzhi pa sogs mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i phyogs la mngon byang lnga bskyed yod pa ltar na/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul snga ma'i rim pas 'dre'o/ /mngon rtogs phal che ba las 'od kyi gong bu las sa bon dang/ de las 'bras bus rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed par bshad pa yin te/ ji skad du rtsa rgyud las/ hūṃ dang aṃ gi rdo rje che/ khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'od kyi gong bu las sa bon 'od zer 'bar ba grub pas ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu char mtshon la/ sa bon de las 'bras bus rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa ni ma'i mngal nas btsas pa mtshon cing*/ de rnams nyid kyis sprul pa'i sku yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang sku bltams pa'ang mtshon pa yin no/ / lnga pa ni 'od zer spro bsdus zhing sbyong ba ni/ lha'i thugs kar sa bon gdan dang bcas pa tsam bsgoms pas kyang sems dpa' sum brtsegs don gyi sgom pa yin te/ de yang sa bon gyi yi ge gdan dang bcas pa ni ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ zla phyed thig le nā da rnams ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mtshon pa yin no/ /'di la slob dpon mi thub zla bas sgrub thabs yan lag drug par sems dpa' sum brtsegs dngos su bskyed pa bshad de/

'dis ni mngal nas btsas pa'i sems can gyi sems gyi nus pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ sprul pa'i sku bltams nas ye shes lhag par spro ba mtshon/ 'od zer spro bsdus zhing sbyang ba ni/ snod bcud 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rags pa lhag par rgyas pa dang*/ rdzogs sm-in sbyang gsum gyi lhag ma la ci rigs par spyod pa mtshon pa yin no/ / drug pa skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus pa 'phel ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pas gdul bya yongs su sm-in par mdzad pa mtshon pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa gzhug pa ni lo bcu drug gam bcu gnyis lon pa na 'dod pa'i yul rnams la bye brag phyed pas/ lus sems kyi mthu yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ chags bral brnyes pa'i tshul bstan pa mtshon pa yin no/ /de dag ni rjes chags kyi yan lag yin te/ mngon byang gi tshe nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rjes chags dang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gyi rjes chags dang*/ dam tshig sems dpa' la/ ye shes pa bstims pas kyang bde ba chen po skye ba dang*/ 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhu ba gnyis ni rjes chags dngos yin pas so/ / de ltar rjes chags de rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' ni bde ba chen po'i ngo bo dang*/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag yin la/ yan lag 'di yang*/ bde ba chen po'i lam dngos dang*/ yan lag drug gi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir de dang cha mthun no/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la de nyid kyi dag sbyor dang*/ dbang gzhi'i sa mtshams dbye ba dang*/ rgyas gdab kyi dbye ba bshad pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i steng du dbang bskur bas lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par tshang ba yin la/ de nyid rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel bas/

las kyi mtha' la gnas pa dang*/ byang chub snying por sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni smin mtshams kyi 'khor lo dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying kha rnams rim pa bzhin lus ngag yid gsum gyi snang ba 'byung ba'i rtsa yi ge'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas 'jog pa dang/ lus kyi dri ma dag byed bum dbang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag byed gsang dbang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin pa'i phyir/ smin mtshams yan chad gang ba bum pa bum dbang*/ mgrin pa yan chad gang ba gsang dbang*/ snying kha yan chad gang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi mtshon don du 'jog pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa dri ma mtha' dag sbyong byed yin pa'i phyir bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus gang ba dang sbyor ba yin no/ /bum dbang gi dag pa'i skabs su/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bsam pa ni bum dbang gi lam bskyed pa'i rim pa yin la/ de mthar phyin tshad/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga la gsal snang thob pa yin no/ /gsang dbang gi dag pa'i tshe lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya sogs bsam pa ni/ gsang dbang gi lam rang byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ de nyid 'khor lo bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa yin pas so/ /sher dbang gi dag pa'i tshe/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa bsam pa ni/ sher dbang gi lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la/ de nyid mthar phyin pa'i tshad/ rtsa rnams byang chub sems kyi gang ste/ 'jug shes drug bde stong gi ye shes 'char bas so/ /dbang bzhi pa'i mthar rigs bdag 'byung ba ni/ dbang de bskur bas dbang gi bya ba thams cad rdzogs par mtshon pa yin no/ /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs bdag 'byung ba ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje rba rlabs kyi skabs su byang chub sems kyi bsgrod pa dang*/

rtsa rnams gtsug tor du thim pa mtshon pa yin no/ / gsum pa rgyas gdab kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/ spyir gzugs can du snang ba thams cad rnam rig tsam yin pa ni/ lus la sems kyi rgyas gdab dang*/ sems nyid khams gsum gyi dngos por snang ba ni/ sems la lus kyi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad rgyu? 'bras phan tshun 'brel ba can yin pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu rgyas gdab cing*/ 'bras bu la rgyus gdab pa mtshon pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi rgyas gdab pa mtshon pa yin no/ /de rnams dang mthun par lha rnams kyang rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa yin te/ gtso bo yab yum mi bskyod pa'i rigs la/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ gau ri rnam snang gi ngo bo dang*/ pukkā si sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bo la mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan pa ni/ lus la sems kyi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ tsau ri rin 'byung dang*/ shā wā rī mā ma kī la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan pa ni/ sems la lus kyi rgyas gdab pa yin no/ /bai ta li 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ tsanṭa li gos dkar mo'i ngo bo la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan pa ni/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab pa dang*/ ghasma ri don yod grub pa'i ngo bo dang*/ ḍom bi ni dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bo la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa ni/ 'bras bu la rgyus gdab pa mtshon no/ / de ltar rgyas gdab bya dang 'debs byed gnyis rigs gcig pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi rgya dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad gzugs phung rnam par dag pa sku rdo rje dang*/ mi bskyod pa rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa thugs rdo rje dang*/ 'od dpag med 'dod chags rnam par dag pa dang*/ rin 'byung nga rgyal dang ser sna rnam par dag pa dang*/ don yod grub pa phrag dog rnam par dag pa yin zhing*/ de ltar nyon mongs pa bzhi las 'dod chags ni rgyu yin la/

gzhan ni 'bras bu'o/ / de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung po dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ nyer spyod rnams la chags pa ni 'dod chags yin la/ de la brten nas rang rgyud kyis phung po la dmigs nas mtho bar sems pa ni nga rgyal dang*/ yo byad longs spyod rnams la brkam zhing chags pa ni ser sna dang*/ bdag nyid la chags pa'i rkyen gyis gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs la sdang ba'i phrag dog kyang 'byung ngo*/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba ni mi bskyod pa'i yan lag yin te/ dbang bskur ba ni bum chu'i bya ba dang 'brel ba yin la/ chu khams rnam par dag pa mā ma kī dang*/ mā ma ki mi bskyod pa'i yum yin pas so/ /lha la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa na/ de nyid kyi nga rgyal bzung bar bya ba yin te/ dbang bskur ba'i yan lag gi sa mtshams shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i yan lag phyi ma gsum la'ang rigs 'dre'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ dam tshig rdzas dngos su yod na mchog yin la/ med kyang bsam pas rung ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sha rnams thams cad med na yang*/ / thams cad bsam pas rnam par dag /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi myang ba nang gi mchod pa yin na'ang*/ mchod pa'i yan lag las zur du phyung ba ni/ rgyal ba rigs drug gi dag pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /de ltar na bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag yin te/ bdud rtsi ni mgrin par myang ba yin la/ mgrin pa ni ngag gi gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ ngag gi rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med yin pas so/ / lnga pa ni/ gong du smos pa ltar rig ma brgyad kyi mchod pa 'di la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa tshang ba yin zhing*/ mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag yin te/ lha rnams 'phrin las la bskul ba ni mchod pa la rags las shing*/

don yod grub pa yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi ngo bo yin pas so/ /drug pa ni/ khyaud ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /zhes sogs kyis kha sbyor yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bstod pa yin la/ bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag te/ rin chen 'byung ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan kyi ngo bo yin zhing*/ bstod pa yang yon tan brjod pa'i tshig yin pas so/ /de ltar bdud rtsi myang ba dang mchod pa dang bstod pa ste yan lag gsum bsgoms pas/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la sems can rnams gnas dang longs spyod dang*/ nye bar spyod pa rnams la rang dbang du gyur zhing*/ longs spyod pa mtshon pas spyod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos la mngon sangs rgyas nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod pa dang bstod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba lam du byed pa yin no/ /de ltar na bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo thams cad la sbyang bya 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pas de sbyong ba dang*/ sbyangs 'bras mya ngan 'das pa'i rnam pa dang mthun pas/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa gnyis tshang dgos shing*/ de dag la bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ mar bltas 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag dang mthun pa dang/ yar bltas rnam byang gi 'dra 'bag dang mthun pa/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa ni/ lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa dang*/ nga rgyal la bslab pa gnyis su 'dus shing*/ lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad cig car du gsal 'debs pa dang*/ rim gyi gsal 'debs pa'i tshul gnyis las/ rim gyis gsal 'debs pa'i tshul la lugs mi 'dra ba mang na yang*/ brgyud pa 'di dang rjes su 'brel ba ni/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi lam skor nas 'byung ba ltar/ dmigs thun sum cu so gnyis dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid nas 'byung ltar/ dmigs thun bdun dang*/ barwi pa'i lugs kyi gdams pa la dmigs thun bcu bdun 'byungab ste/

lugs gsum du yod/ gnyis pa nga rgyal la bslab pa ni/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa/ spyir bslab pa dang/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i cha shas re re la bslab par bya ba yin cing*/ de yang bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i zhal brgyad ni/ kyai rdo rje'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam thar brgyad kyi ye shes yin pa sogs thams cad la so so nas bslab par bya ba yin te/ de la tha mal gyi snang ba'i gnyen por lha'i rnam pa la slab pa dang*/ tha mal du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por lha'i nga rgyal la bslab pa yin no/ /lam 'di gnyis bsgoms pas gsal snang thob pa'i tshe/ sdug bsngal bden pa mngon gyur pa 'gag cing 'khor ba spong ba yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun 'di ma gtogs pa/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma

yin/ /de dang rnam par 'gal bar gyur pa'i yid/ /des ni mngon sum du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi rang bzhin can/ /gang yin des ni kun rtog 'char mi byed/ /ces gsungs so/ / gzhan yang lha'i rnam pa dang*/ mos pa sgom pas grol bar 'gyur ba ni/ lam byed bzhi tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /lam byed bzhi ni/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa/ rnam pa lam du byed pa/ mos pa lam du byed pa/ byin rlabs lam du byed pa ste bzhi'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa la/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas par mos zhing zhen pas/ de nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ nor bu'i 'od la nor bur zhen pas mthar nor bu thob nus pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa yid la byas pas thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na bsam gtan pa 'ga' zhig gis me'i rnam pa yid la byas pas/ zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas bdud kyi gnas su me sprul nus pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa ni de ltar sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dngos su mos pa mthar phyin pa na/ de nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ shā ri'i bus dmyal ba'i me chur mos pas dngos su chur 'gyur ba yin no/ / bzhi pa ni/ lhag pa'i lhas byin brlabs pas kyang grol bar 'thad de/ yi dam lha'i byin rlabs tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes shing sa dang lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye bas mthar sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur te/ lci ba'i gong bu gser du byin gyis brlabs pas gser du gyur pa bzhin no/ /de ltar lam byed bzhi po 'di dag bskyed rim thams cad kyi/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo kun la tshang ba dang*/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa nas brtsams te/ lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'i bar thams cad du lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa dang*/

nga rgyal la bslab pa gnyis tshang dgos shing*/ gnyis ka'ang rgya che ba dang gsal ba'i ngo bo yin la/ de dag stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pa'i tshe zab pa'i rnal 'byor yang yin pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'am/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa la bslab pa yin no/ / gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi/ brten dkyil bzhi'o/ /gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems te/ gsum du grags pa dang*/ dbang gong ma gsum dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam bzhag zhib mor gtan la dbab dgos mod/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdu ba'i rim pa 'od gsal du 'jug pa'am/ yang na bzlas pa'i mthar bsdu bas kyang rung ste/ dag pa dran pa dang bzlas brjod ni rjes sbyong yin pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gsal gdab dgos pa'i nges pa med la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas de nyid bsgoms na shin tu legs pa'ang yin pas so/ / gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor te brgyad do/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa ngag tu brjod cing*/ don zhib mor bsam pa yin cing*/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /zhes pa mtsho skyes kyi sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba yin la/ gzhan rnams ni rtsa rgyud las 'byung ba bsdus pa'o/ /de la chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor ro gcig pa'i bdag nyid kyi sku la byams pa'i rang bzhin sku mdog nag po/ snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi spyan dmar ba/ snying rje chen po dang dbyer med pas rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa'i rang bzhin gyi zhal re re la spyan gsum dang*/

rnam thar dag pa'i zhal brgyad de/ de yang rtsa zhal nag po ni gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ g.yas zhal dkar po gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ g.yon zhal dmar po khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar steng zhal dud kha 'gog pa'i rnam thar zhal lhag ma bzhi ni gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi'o/ /stong nyid bcu drug rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa phyag bcu drug ste/ stong nyid bcu drug ni/ nang dang*/ phyi dang*/ phyi nang dang*/ chen po dang*/ stong nyid dang*/ don dam pa dang*/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ mtha' las 'das pa dang*/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa dang*/ dor ba med pa dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ chos thams cad dang*/ dngos po med pa dang*/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong nyid rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni mthong bya dang mthong tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin la/ stong nyid phyi ma gnyis ni/ rang gi ngo bo stong mi stong gi tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin zhing*/ de ltar brgyad ni g.yas kyi phyag brgyad do/ /stong nyid bar pa brgyad ni g.yon gyi phyag brgyad do/ / stong nyid bcu drug gi ngos 'dzin saṃmbu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma nas 'byung ba dang*/ dbus mtha' rtsa 'grel nas 'byung ba ni dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu snang ngo*/ /thod pa bcu drug ni/ phyag bcu drug dang sbyor rgyu'i bde ba chen po bcu drug te/ dga' ba bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin no/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na gnas pa'i srog chags brgyad ni/ rdo rje gur las/ blo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ khong skam 'dze dang shri dzi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la/ / glong la sogs rim bzhin shes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gyi nad brgyad mtshon pa yin la/ de dag kha nang du lta ba ni sku la bsdu ba'i tshul gyis sems can rnams kyi de dag sel bar mtshon par yin no/ /g.yon gyi thod pa'i nang gi lha brgyad ni/

dbang phyug brgyad mtshon pa dang*/ de dag sems can la stsal ba ni gdong phyir phyogs pas mtshon pa yin no/ /yon tan brgyad ni/ kha cig sku'i dbang phyug la sogs pa mchog gi dngos grub brgyad la sbyar ba ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi gangs dod mi skom shing*/ kha cig phra yang la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub la sbyor ba ni/ sbyor tshul mi bde bas/ des na bla ma gong ma phal cher gyi bzhed pa ltar khams brgyad rnam par dag pa'i/ dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtshon pa yin no/ /de ltar na khams brgyad po de rnams kyi/ snyigs ma'i cha rnams zad cing*/ dwangs ma rnams stobs su gyur pa ste/ de las stobs su gyur pas ni/ sred med kyi bu lta bur stobs che ba dang*/ chu stobs su gyur pas na nad dang tshor ba sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ me stobs su gyur pas gcig dang du mar snang ba sogs cho 'phrul ston pa dang*/ rlung stobs su gyur pas ni/ yid kyi shugs kyis 'gro ba dang*/ nam mkha' stobs su gyur pas ni/ snod bcud kyi khyad par rnams skye 'jig nus pa dang*/ zla ba ste byang sems stobs su gyur pas/ bdos bcas kyi lus rags pa mi snang zhing grib ma med pa dang*/ nyi ma ste rdul gyi khams stobs su gyur pas ni/ gzi brjid che shing 'od 'bar la/ skye ba mang po dbang du 'du ba dang*/ rnam shes kyi khams stobs su gyur pas 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i bdag nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'o/ /zhabs bzhi ni sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don mthun pa dang/ don spyod pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnam par dag pa/ de dag gis phung po'i bdud dang*/ lha'i bu'i bdud dang*/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud do/ / gdul bya gzhan rgyud la gnas pa'i de dag mtha' dag 'joms pa ni rim pa bzhin du/ tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang*/ drag po rnams so/ /mdun gyi zhabs g.yon bskums pa ni/

stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pa ni thugs rje chen pos mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis gnas pa ni/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma la gnas pa dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /zhabs bzhi char skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs su mdzad pa ltar g.yon gnyis bskums pas/ 'khor ba la mi gnas pa dang*/ g.yas gnyis brkyangs pas/ myang 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa dang*/ de gnyis bsdoms pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu mtshon pa yin no/ / phyi rol tu lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba dang*/ nang du rnam par rtog pa 'joms pa'i phyir du khro bo'i skur ston pa'o/ /rgyan gyi dag pa ni/ gug bskyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga zhes mdor bstan pa dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par bshad par yin cing*/ phyag rgya lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du gnas pa dang*/ ye shes lnga'i dag par gnas pas na/ ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon pa dang*/ thal chen gyis sku lus thams cad brgyan pa ni rdo rje 'chang dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes la gnas pa mtshon pa yin no/ / rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor rnams kyi dag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dngos bstan las/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dag par gsungs pa thams cad skabs 'dir rnal 'byor ma lha dgur bsdus pa yin te/ de yang sa spyod ma dang*/ mkha' spyod ma ni rdo rje bdag med ma dang*/ rdo rje ma dang*/ dkar mo dang*/ chu ma dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni rim pa bzhin du gau ri la sogs pa phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang sbyor ba yin no/ /des na/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang*/ reg bya dang*/ chos khams dang/ nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa ni bdag med ma dang*/

gzugs kyi skye mched dang*/ gzugs phung rnam par dag pa/ gau ri dang*/ sgra dang*/ tshor phung rnam par dag pa tsau ri dang*/ 'du shes rnam par dag pa bai tā lī dang*/ ro dang 'du byed rnam par dag pa ghasma ri dang*/ sa khams rnam par dag pa pukkā si dang*/ chu khams rnam par dag pa shwa wa rī dang*/ me khams rnam par dag pa tsand+ra li dang*/ rlung khams rnams par dag pa ḍom bi ni rnams so/ /de skad du yang brtag gnyis las/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la ni dkar mo bshad/ /'du shes chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal byor ma gnas so/ /zhes dang*/ gzugs la rtag tu dkar mo bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma ri rab grags/ /reg las spyod ma zhes brjod do/ / chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma zhes dang*/ sa ni pukkā si zhes bshad/ /chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mo rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dug lnga rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid ni/ phyogs kyi lha mo rnams dang*/ bdag med ma la sbyar ba'ang rung mod/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gtso bo nyid la sbyor ba yin cing*/ lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshe 'phar ma nang ma'i lha rnams la sbyor ba yin no/ /de ltar na bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo ni/ chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa mtshon cing*/ g.yas kyi gri gug ni/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i rtsa nyon drug gcod pa dang*/ g.yon gyi thod pa ni dngos po dang*/ dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag 'joms pa dang*/ nang gi khrag ni bdud bzhi'i khrag ste/ de btul ba dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyis zhal gcig /thabs shes kyi bdag nyid kyi phyag gnyis ma'o/ /gau ri sku mdog nag mo ni/ drag po'i 'phrin las kyi 'gro ba'i don byed pa dang*/
